Picoboi is an experiment by @farilyaz in running small language models directly inside a website, on your own device. I’m exploring what they can do with features like web scraping, local memory, calculators, and other small tools. It’s a work in progress: the model and these features aren’t connected yet, and I’m figuring out what works.
